title: Construct Binary Tree from Preorder and Inorder Traversal
summary: Rebuild a binary tree from its preorder and inorder traversals.

tests.explain: The first preorder value, 3, is the root. In the inorder list, 9 is left of 3 (the left subtree) and 15, 20, 7 are right of it.
A single node is its own preorder and inorder.
A perfect tree with three levels.

hints: Preorder visits root, left subtree, right subtree. So the very first preorder value is the root. What does the inorder list tell you once you know the root?

Find the root in inorder. Everything to its left is the left subtree, everything to its right is the right subtree. The size of the left part tells you how many preorder values belong to the left subtree.

Build recursively on index ranges instead of copying arrays, and use a Map from value to inorder index so each root is found in O(1). Consume preorder from a single moving index: build the left subtree first, then the right.

complexity.time: O(n): each node is created once and located with an O(1) map lookup
complexity.space: O(n) for the map plus O(h) recursion
